courier-relay/protocol-versioning: Courier Relay protocol versioning (main.py): CURRENT_PROTOCOL="1" and SUPPORTED_PROTOCOLS=("1",). An omitted "protocol" in a request selects CURRENT_PROTOCOL; an explicit supported version selects that version and stays supported after a newer current version is introduced. When adding protocol N: add a per-version rule function (protocol 1 is accepted_receipts_v1, contract in vendor/protocol-1.md: identity=(account_id, delivery_id), accept earliest occurred_at UTC instant, ties -> smallest record_id by code point, accepted keep original fields/order), dispatch on version in count(), update CURRENT_PROTOCOL only when N becomes current. Timestamps parsed via parse_instant() (RFC3339, Z or numeric offset, compared as UTC). Public suites name protocols explicitly; run python3 test_public.py --cases public_tests/<file>.json. Source: issue trial-vbm and vendor/protocol-1.md.
